findings.summary: Adversarial review round 1 [operability]: the image job runs on Image Updater's write-back commit to deploy/.argocd-source-sdlc-board.yaml, rebuilds with a new digest, and loops.
findings.reason: CI's push trigger ignores deploy/.argocd-source-sdlc-board.yaml (paths-ignore), so the write-back commit runs no workflow; .dockerignore also leaves deploy/, argocd/, docs/ and .sdlc/ out of the build context, so chart or docs commits don't change the image's inputs.

findings.summary: Adversarial review round 1 [web]: a web tab open past the Access session follows Cloudflare's redirect cross-origin, fails with 'JsValue(TypeError: Failed to fetch …)' every 30 s, and nothing says the login expired.
findings.reason: The web fetch sets redirect: manual; an opaqueredirect answer shows 'your Cloudflare Access login has expired: reload the page' in the bar over the kept board. Other non-2xx answers show their status.

findings.summary: Task review round 3: the envFrom swap let the hand-applied Secret set any variable the server reads (LINEAR_ENDPOINT, BOARD_NO_ACCESS, …).
findings.reason: Reverted to the two named secretKeyRef entries, GITHUB_TOKEN optional.

findings.summary: Task review round 3: every 401 was reported as an expired login, including the server's own 401 while its Access keys aren't loaded.
findings.reason: Only an opaqueredirect is reported as an expired login; a 401 shows as '401 Unauthorized'.

findings.summary: Task review round 3: no automated test covers the expired-login path (crates/app/src/main.rs web fetch); Verify round 2 should observe it in a browser.
Build round 1: no test checks a token signed with a newly rotated key is accepted once the keys are reread; no test covers the native app sending the service-token headers.
